notes:
METHOD: every figure was read on 2026-10-10 from the page URL given, fetched by plain GET (curl) or from the euttaranchal.com directory pages crawled by plain GET. No rate or date comes from memory. WebSearch was used only to find URLs; search-result summaries were never used as a source for a number. Access blocks not bypassed: gmvnonline.com (HTTP 403), gujarattourism.com and booking.gujarattourism.com (HTTP 403), irctctourism.com (JS-only, empty to a plain GET), mtdc.co (rates load by date from a booking-engine API that errored with 429; not hammered), hopehallmatheran.com (domain now parked).

HEADLINE: most of these regions do NOT publish month-based seasonal cards. Only 2 current Garhwal cards and 1 Gir lodge give a clean same-room season vs off-season pair. Odisha (3 Puri hotels), North-East/Darjeeling/Sikkim (6), Maharashtra (2) and Karnataka (3) cards are flat, weekday/weekend, or have an undated 'seasonal hike' with no figure. Do not infer seasonality for those places from this file; the absence of a printed season is itself the finding for Puri (the three hotels in rows plus Hotel Shakti International, https://shaktiinternational.in/hotel/room-tariff-and-offers/, Super Deluxe 5,000 double: all flat), Cherrapunji (flat 1 Oct 2026-30 Sep 2027), Darjeeling Elgin (flat Apr 2025-Mar 2026) and Lonavala (weekend uplift only).

GROUP 1 GARHWAL (Guptkashi, Uttarkashi, Rudraprayag, Joshimath/Auli, Devprayag, Barkot, Sonprayag/Sitapur): usable pairs, all private. (a) Hotel Saidham Joshimath (hotel-supplied card on eUttaranchal directory, undated, MAP, 12% GST extra), Double Deluxe: Sep-19 Dec 3,900; 20 Dec-10 Jan and May-Jun 5,000; Jul, Aug, 11 Jan-30 Apr 3,250. Low/mid = 0.83, low/peak = 0.65. (b) Blackberry Cottages, Auli (own site, undated, EP): High Nov-Feb and May-Jun 3,500; Mid Mar-Apr and Sep-Oct 3,000; Low Jul-Aug 3,000; blackout 20 Dec-5 Jan 3,800; premium room 4,500/4,200/4,000/5,200; low/high = 0.86 and 0.89. Median low/high across these three room cards = 0.86 (0.65 if Saidham's May-Jun band is the denominator). Two 2016-17 Uttarkashi cards (Shivlinga Tourist Complex, KNB Heritage) are STALE and give ratios 0.57/0.42 on tiny budget rooms; use only for calendar shape: peak 15 Apr-30 Jun and 1 Sep-Diwali, low 1 Jul-31 Aug and Diwali-14 Apr (Shivlinga); peak 1 May-30 Jun, mid 1 Jul-Diwali, off Diwali-31 Mar (KNB). Sahaj Villa (2017) peak 15 Apr-20 Jun. The same hotel's CURRENT own-site page (Shivlinga Resort Uttarkashi and Yamunotri road, Syanachatti) publishes a 'May & June 2026' card that is 8-16 percent above its 'w.e.f. 1 Apr 2023' card, but the years differ and the 2023 card is not labelled off-season, so ratio_valid=false. WHAT THE CARDS CALL SEASON: May-June in every card; Sept to Diwali is high or mid in the older Uttarkashi cards and mid in Saidham/Blackberry; 20 Dec-5/10 Jan is a peak window; Jul-Aug is the lowest band in all five dated cards. NOT FOUND: any Guptkashi, Rudraprayag, Devprayag or Sonprayag/Sitapur card with two rates, and any GMVN tariff (site blocked, no dated newspaper report found). The eUttaranchal pages for Guptkashi/Rudraprayag/Barkot hotels print flat 'Rs X' cards or boilerplate '2026-2027 season and off-season' text with no numbers. Auli Resort (Royal Village) prints one period 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026, 3,000 + 5% GST.

GROUP 2 NORTH-EAST / DARJEELING / SIKKIM (Gangtok, Pelling, Lachung, Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Shillong, Cherrapunji, Kaziranga, Tawang): zero valid pairs. Only month definitions: Hotel Ladakh House Pelling prints 'season time is March, April, May, Oct and Dec, rest are off season' (season rate 3,500 CP, no off rate). Diphlu River Lodge Kaziranga: season = park open Nov 2026 to end Apr 2027, monsoon plan 11 May-Oct 2026, but plans differ (all-inclusive per adult vs B&B+dinner per cottage), ratio invalid. Infinity Kaziranga prints one Oct 2025-Jun 2026 card. Flat: White Conch Gangtok, Elgin Darjeeling (1 Apr 2025-31 Mar 2026), Cherrapunjee Holiday Resort (1 Oct 2026-30 Sep 2027). Nothing found for Lachung, Kalimpong, Shillong, Tawang (Elgin Silver Oaks Kalimpong, Nor-Khill Gangtok and Mount Pandim Pelling pages have no rate table; Sinclairs, Mayfair, Hotel Tibet, Sonam Delek sites show no tariff). An IRCTC Tourism package page reportedly defines Sikkim/Darjeeling peak and lean months, but it is JS-only and I could not fetch it, so it is NOT included; a lead only (package code EHH124).

GROUP 3 ODISHA (Puri, Gopalpur, Konark): 0 pairs. Victoria Club Hotel (valid 1 Apr 2026-31 Mar 2027), Puri Holiday Resort and Hotel Puri Beach Resort (Oct 2023, stale) all print one flat card; Victoria notes 'holiday higher tariff on selected dates' without dates or amounts. OTDC Panthanivas sites (otdc.odisha.gov.in, panthanivas.com) did not respond and bookodisha.com shows no tariff text. Nothing found for Gopalpur or Konark.

GROUP 4 GUJARAT (Saputara, Dwarka, Somnath, Gir/Sasan): 1 pair. Asiatic Lion Lodge, Sasan Gir (own site, AC Deluxe Cottage, MAP, ex-GST): 16 Oct-31 Mar winter card 8,500; 1 Apr-15 Jun special summer 7,499; 16 Jun-15 Oct monsoon 5,550; Diwali and Christmas 10,500. Monsoon/winter = 0.65 (CP 4,500/6,900 = 0.65), summer/winter = 0.88, Diwali-Xmas = 1.24. Cards are dated 2024 / 2024-25 (still the live pages). Saputara, Dwarka and Somnath: TCGL Toran tariffs are behind a 403 and no private own-site seasonal card was found.

GROUP 5 MAHARASHTRA (Mahabaleshwar, Lonavala, Matheran, Alibaug, Tarkarli/Malvan): 0 pairs. Mahabaleshwar already covered in T3 (Dreamland, Gautam, Girivihar: no off-season rate). Hotel Gautam Lonavala (from 1 Apr 2026): weekday/weekend only (Executive 4,000 vs 5,000 room-only, taxes included). Madhuvan Farms Alibaug: flat undated. MTDC resort tariffs (Mahabaleshwar, Matheran, Tarkarli) could not be read: new mtdc.co loads rates by date from a booking API (429) and the only PDF found (2020 chart) is a reseller image, so I did not use it. A Nahar Retreat (Kothagiri, Nilgiris, not in this batch) card does print Season (10 Apr-30 Jun, 11 Dec-30 Jan) vs Offseason (1 Jul-10 Dec, 1 Feb-31 Mar) with Classic Double CP 6,500 vs 5,000 (0.77) for 2024-25, https://www.naharretreat.com/tariff/, offered as a bonus data point for the Nilgiris, not counted here.

GROUP 6 KARNATAKA (Coorg, Chikmagalur, Gokarna, Hampi, Mysore): 0 pairs. The Last Resort Chikmagalur: weekday 1,950 / weekend 2,150 / 20-30 Dec 2,500 per person, no month seasons. Palm Era Cottages Coorg: stale flat card. Om Beach Resort Gokarna (JLR): 'seasonal hike applicable', no figure. Hampi and Madikeri/Mysore KSTDC cards are in T2.

COVERAGE VS TARGET: asked for 3+ properties per group; met only for Garhwal (counting stale and weak rows). The ledger's season months for Odisha, North-East, Maharashtra and Karnataka cannot be set from printed hotel cards found here; they need another source (state corporation PDFs that are currently blocked or image-only, or hotel-by-hotel email requests).
